summary: Authored comprehensive vertical slice plan defining 5 ordered end-to-end slices for SkillSwap in artifacts/slices-module-04.md and progress/decomposition/module-04/slices-module-04.md. Each slice includes specific scope, extensive anti-scope boundaries, explicit dependencies, non-technical acceptance criteria, and complexity ratings.
evidence: Defined 5 ordered vertical slices: Slice 1 Browse and Book (Seeded Data, S), Slice 2 User Authentication & Dashboard (M), Slice 3 Provider Self-Service & Availability (M), Slice 4 Payment Escrow & Checkout (M), Slice 5 Cancellation, Refund & Review (M).
Every slice contains extensive anti-scope preventing scope creep across auth, payments, notifications, calendar sync, and admin dashboards.
Provided 5-step non-technical acceptance criteria verifiable by end users without inspecting code or databases.
